entities.name: Annie Lorrain Smith
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Annie Lorrain Smith was a British lichenologist whose Lichens (1921) was an essential textbook for several decades. She was also a mycologist and founder member of the British Mycological Society, where she served as president for two terms.
